verdict.rationale: Penpot's documented AI capability is an MCP server that lets external agents and LLMs read and act on design files. That is an integration path to outside AI, not AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the product. The '113+' plugin marketplace mentions AI tools, but these are community extensions, not a first-party feature. Nothing in the pack shows built-in AI analysis of a user's data within Penpot.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
